info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of their auto insurance quotes. This endpoint serves as a tool for both policyholders and insurance agents to monitor progress and updates on submitted quotes. By leveraging this API, users can easily check the state of their quotes, facilitating better planning and decision-making regarding their insurance options. Common consumers of this API include insurance company representatives and end-users looking to follow up on their insurance inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of quotes in the system. You can use this to check if a quote is pending, accepted, or rejected, providing insight into the handling of quotes within the application.
